newsitem.title: USA: AMR says costs still too high.
newsitem.headline: AMR says costs still too high.

text.p: AMR Corp said Wednesday it had a good third quarter though costs are still too high.
The parent company of American Airlines reported earnings per share rose to $3.06 from $2.64 a year earlier.
"Although our airline costs are still higher than we'd like them to be, we had a good third quarter," it said.

"Robust demand, a favorable pricing environment and the continued profitable growth of our non-airline businesses offset a dramatic increase in fuel prices and American Airlines' $21 million portion of the travel agency litigation settlement," it said in a statement.
Company officials declined further comment until a teleconference scheduled for 1400 CDT/1900 GMT.
